paragraphs: Chapter 923
230th Episode: Invasion and Assault (4)
Just facing Paelrito's back was enough to feel it.
He was a swordman who could slice everything without a sword. He was a figure who had reached the apex of martial arts called swordsmanship, undoubtedly a transcendent.
The Sword Demon.
The only being in the demon world who could look down upon billions of demons, excluding Zito.
Sword Qi could gush out at any moment from the magic filled air. The party, with their swords drawn, braced their senses in preparation. Even Murakan silently enhanced his spirit shield.
However, as if such a shabby surprise was unnecessary, Paelrito slowly waited for Jin to speak, still not turning back.
"Sword Demon, Paelrito Belgasium. You recognized me right away."
"Of course. As soon as I ascended, the first thing I felt wasn't the bright light of the real sun I had longed for underground, but... the fact that Sakiel Grosh no longer existed in this world."
"You must have cherished her a lot."
"She was a person indispensable for the Demon World."
A heavy voice filled with restrained sorrow.
Paelrito couldn't help but recall what Kellyak had once told him.
-In my opinion, Gyeong hasn't completely calmed down yet.
Was it possible to fight while completely letting go of this sorrow?
There was a loss that was unbearable even for him who had ascended to transcendence. Paelrito acknowledged that fact as he gazed at his reflection in the barrier of Talaris with calm eyes.
"How was Sakiel's end?"
"It wasn't pitiful."
"I'm not asking something so obvious. Jin Runkandel, what did she seem to want in her final moments?"

"Paelrito. To me, Sakiel was merely an invader. She was just a terrible monster who could use millions, tens of millions, even billions of her subordinates as sacrifices for Zito, even willing to sacrifice herself. So I killed her. Are you asking me what the sentiment of such a lunatic was? How would I know that? Even if I did, I have no intention of babbling for an enemy."
"Ah, right... I momentarily forgot. You're still an unrefined tribe who hasn't been purified by pain."
Creak...!
Suddenly, a crack appeared in the middle of the Talaris's barrier that Paelrito was watching. Paelrito's energy began to tear the barrier.
"Let's postpone commemorating Sakiel for now. Today, here, the Holy Land will vanish without a trace."
Then the moment Paelrito drew his sword.
First, Jin rushed and stabbed his sword into the back of Paelrito. Almost simultaneously, Murakan exhaled his breath, and Dante and Hedo scattered left and right, shooting their sword energies.
Clang-!
However, Paelrito was faster in breaking the boundary. The group's attack missed, and Paelrito was already passing through Ayura's shield and Talaris's boundary.
'He's breaking Bigungju's boundary this easily!'
'He's fast, even faster than Jin. I can't read his movements...!'
Although the density of the boundary that enveloped the entire kingdom had to be low, Talaris was undoubtedly operating at full power.
Yet, the boundary was torn like paper by a single strike without any preparation.
Below it were the priests, knights, and citizens of the kingdom. Paelrito wasn't here to distinguish between soldiers and civilians and kill them in the kingdom.
At this rate, tens of thousands of people will soon be mercilessly killed. Even the best knights of the kingdom could not withstand Paelrito for a minute.

If Paelrito does not fight the group and first targets the citizens for slaughter and destruction, it would be impossible for anyone to stop it perfectly. Even if it were not Jin's group but Sirron and the expeditionary force in their place.
But fortunately.
Ayura left her authority in the kingdom for times like these. Ayura's protective shield was not just to block external invasions.
Tsuaaaaak-!
As soon as Paelrito penetrated Ayura's shield and entered, golden spears were forming in the empty space near him.
'The spear of Lord Ayura...!'
Twenty golden spears that Ayura used as weapons when fighting with Zito.
The weapon of the God emitted sharp light to pierce the intruder. The spear had a power that made even Zito shudder in pain.
Jjeong-!
Paelrito struck the spear that flew directly at him. He seemed to be pushed back by the momentary shock.
But he managed to ward off all the spears flying in all directions without fail. The bounced-off spears whirled around in the air for a while and then targeted Paelrito again.
Due to the spears, Paelrito's speed was slowing down. The group took advantage of this and rushed to Paelrito to attack.
Twenty spears of the god, three swords with a goal of becoming a star, and even Murakan's spirit energy.
All of that was perfectly combined to pressure Paelrito, but he didn't seem cornered at all.
Jin felt a chill.
'If it weren't for Lord Ayura's spears, one of the cities of the kingdom would have already disappeared.'
Shockwaves bursting in the sky were already causing the mountains in sight to crumble. Unending tsunamis rolled in the sea, clouds dispersed shapelessly, and roads and small villages disappeared.
Fortunately, no one seen yet had been killed in the blast. Throughout the battle, Jin had been extending his senses towards the ground to confirm this fact.
The altitude of the battlefield was dropping rapidly.
What Ayulra's spear wanted was clear.

'The spear is driving him away, preventing Paelrito from falling into civilian areas. And that means Ayulra decided that he can't kill Paelrito with just the weapons left in the protective barrier. If we follow this path, the battlefield will soon become the Bellium Plains.'
At least in the Bellium Plains, the shockwaves from the battle wouldn't sweep up and kill the people of the Holy Kingdom.
Paelrito also roughly guessed Jin's intentions and those of Ayulra.
'So it's the will of the Immortal who says he can fight Zito head-on, it's annoying. It'll be difficult to attack the Holy Kingdom before all the spears are gone.'
Then he would get rid of the spears.
Having decided so, Paelrito willingly accepted the flow of the spear. Now, he was more focused on Jin's attack than on the spear.

"Jin Run Kandel. You asked me if I spared Sakiel. Now it's my turn to ask. Are these bugs living in this Holy Kingdom precious to you? You keep worrying about them. It's surprising that you can afford such concern while facing me."
Paelrito noticed Jin constantly checking on the civilian area.
His surprise was sincere. Paelrito was amazed that Jin could withstand his killing intent while caring about other things.
It was his first time seeing such a 'human' so resilient. It was a moment to remind him again why the world needed the order of suffering.

"There's no reason for them to be sacrificed in a war between those with power. You guys, who don't hesitate to use your subordinates as offerings, probably can't understand. You said you spared Sakiel, but if Zito commanded it, you would have used Sakiel like a consumable."
Kwaaaaang……!
The fall ended. The moment Jin's group fell into the middle of the Bellium Plains, the twenty spears poured down on Paelrito's head all at once.
But Paelrito knocked all the spears away in one go.
Between the thick dust caused by Ayulra's spears scattering and sticking everywhere, Paelrito's eyes flashed.
The Fifth of Sword Dance
Netherworld Sword
For a moment, the group felt their vision blur.
It was a phenomenon caused by Paelrito's magic binding the group's physical bodies. Hundreds of strands of magic sprung up from somewhere, incessantly poking into the group's eyes.
"Gak!"
Right after he dispersed his magical energy to evade, Hedo was the first one to be attacked.

Hedo was certainly aware of the moment when the purple blade energy was about to hit him. Even though Paelrito's sword was said to be as fast as light, Hedo, a superhuman being, would still perceive it.
However, the moment he thought he had blocked it...
Hedo's blurred vision was turned upside down as if his head had been slammed into the ground.
'What...!'
He couldn't understand it.
Because he didn't feel anything touching his body at all. It wasn't as if some unseen force or power had knocked him over, nor had he lost consciousness due to shock and just woken up.
Literally, his vision had suddenly flipped.
For now, Hedo tried to reflexively get up. He had to adjust his posture as quickly as possible and prepare for the next attack if he was to stay alive even after a while.
However, Hedo had not fallen over. He had not been slammed into the ground either. So, the action he was trying to take to regain his balance was instead breaking his original stance.
What was disrupting Hedo's senses was the characteristic of the Underworld Sword displayed by Paelrito.

The extremity of the sword touched by Paelrito was an area where he could twist the opponent's senses with just his will. It was a power closer to reality manipulation, a level above psychic magic, including illusion.
Hedo's vision continued to have issues. It kept flipping upside down and fracturing like shattered glass.
All of this happened in less than a second. With his eyes closed, Hedo was preparing to wake up his inner self. That was a possible response because he was Hedo.
Paelrito pierced his chest with a sword, passing through the sword screens of his comrades who were trying to protect Hedo like the wind.
Thunk-!
The sturdy body acknowledged even by Luna and Runtia was pierced as if it were a child's skin. Blood and flesh splashed.
If his comrades hadn't slightly deviated Paelrito's attack trajectory, the Underworld Sword would have perfectly pierced Hedo's chest.

The sword barely pricked Hedo's shoulder. As Paelrito tried to retrieve his sword, Hedo stabbed his long sword into Paelrito's flank and grabbed his neck with his left hand, so that Paelrito could not dodge Ayura's spear that was now rushing in.
However, Hedo's left hand clutched at the air. Paelrito took exactly one step away from him, turned around, and slashed up Ayura's spear.
No one present here could do exactly what Paelrito just did.
Swoosh!
The perfectly bisected spear was scattered to both sides of Paelrito. He even threatened the rushing party of Jin by warding off the consecutive spears.
Then Paelrito leisurely withdrew his body and stared at Jin's group and the remaining nineteen spears. Still, his killing intent was aimed at Jin.
He was solely targeting Jin.
